description: This Java class 'ShippingMethodsController' is a Spring MVC Controller managing shipping methods configuration in an e-commerce admin panel. It handles displaying, editing, saving, and deleting shipping method configurations, interfacing with 'shippingService' for business logic.

classes.name: ShippingMethodsController
classes.description: Controller class for managing shipping methods configuration in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayShippingMethods
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display all available shipping methods and their configurations for a store.

methods.name: displayShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display a specific shipping method configuration based on its code.

methods.name: saveShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a shipping method's configuration.

methods.name: saveCustomWeightBasedShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save custom weight-based shipping configurations.

methods.name: deleteShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a shipping method configuration based on its code.
